story: Ben wakes up early and takes a shower. He goes downstairs to have a meal. He is interested in these foods and drinks much cola.
title: A Busy Morning
setting: A house with a bathroom and a kitchen.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: A young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater.

sentences.en: Ben wakes up very early today.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben with short brown hair wakes up in his bed.

sentences.en: He takes a warm shower now.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben stands under a shower with water falling.

sentences.en: He looks at the small clock.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben looks at a small round clock on the wall.

sentences.en: Ben walks downstairs to the kitchen.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben walks down the stairs towards a bright kitchen.

sentences.en: Hey, Ben, sit down for a meal!
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna waves her hand at Ben in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Anna is in a grey chair.
sentences.zh: Anna坐在一把灰色的椅子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna with long blonde hair sits in a grey chair.

sentences.en: Ben is interested in these foods.

sentences.zh: 可乐是他最喜欢的饮料。
